liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Windy and Warm**: rare: 6 archived performances [6]
- **Tall Pines**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]
- **Big Sandy River**: rare: 7 archived performances [6]
- **Mother's Only Sleeping**: back after 193 archived shows (792 days); rare: 3 archived performances [6]
- **Bye Bye Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]
- **Portrait of the Blues**: back after 106 archived shows (426 days); rare: 4 archived performances [6]
- **Pear Tree**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [6]
- **Little White Church in the Valley**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **familystrings2020-02-28.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 29 songs; 119 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **familystrings2020-02-28.litz.neumannKM150.flac16**: source not stated; 27 songs; 119 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **billystrings2020-02-28.MG20**: source not stated; 27 songs; 119 min [3]

## Around the show

- Uploader credits the Billy Strings crew and City Opera House staff for helping with the taping [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **familystrings2020-02-28.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's(in front of left stack)>Schoeps KCY 250/051>Schoeps VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II (Recorded at 32 Bit Float/48 Khz) [1]. Also: Chain runs through Schoeps preamp stages into a Sound Devices MixPre-10 II at 32-bit float, 48 kHz; Processed in Sound Forge Pro 13 with fades, resampling and dither to 16-bit/44.1kHz, tracked in CDWAV, encoded to FLAC [1]
- **familystrings2020-02-28.litz.neumannKM150.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Neumann KM150's(in front of left stack)>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II (Recorded at 32 Bit Float/48 Khz) [2]. Also: Neumann mics fed a Sound Devices MixPre-10 II at 32-bit float, 48 kHz, then Sound Forge Pro 13 for 16-bit conversion [2]
- **billystrings2020-02-28.MG20**: taped by Keith Antaya; transferred by Antaya; source: MG20>nBob Actives>Sound Devices MP10ii [3]. Also: Source recorded with MG20 microphones through nBob actives into a Sound Devices MixPre 10ii at 32-bit float; Taper position was in front of the left stack; Files went from SDHC card through Adobe Audition 3.0 and CDWave 1.71 [3]
